findings.title: New helper mutation reaches legacy host PID stop selection
findings.evidence: helper request_target -> comparison_remote -> remote::exec; after timeout remote::exec invokes stop(host,pid), whose script performs host ps/awk -> TERM/KILL. PID<=1 guard does not establish command ownership or prevent PID reuse/foreign descendants. The new helper fixture invokes this real path through fake SSH/WSL.
findings.required_change: Route the helper through the separately independently accepted owned transport cut; no legacy stop/retry on uncertain mutation. Review exact adaptation and fixture before runtime.
findings.runtime_repro: Not executed; source-visible call graph, known open blocker confirmed.

findings.title: Cancelled helper request can still dispatch and ownership returns before remote completion
findings.evidence: execute calls request without checking active; comparison_remote spawns remote::exec before its first active check. Even active()==false at entry can send the prepared execute ticket. On cancellation/deadline the outer function returns while the spawned remote operation remains live, releasing UI busy ownership early. Recovery wording is honest but does not prevent this dispatch.
findings.required_change: Check cancellation at actual pre-send boundary and retain/capture completion ownership until the actual transport returns, including any nested queue/connect work. Use accepted owned transport with explicit unknown outcome and no automatic replay.
findings.runtime_repro: Not executed; deterministic source ordering establishes the boundary failure.

findings.title: Windows alternate truncation relies on unestablished hard-link exclusion
findings.evidence: Actual-handle linkcount1 checks reject preexisting aliases, but the alternate is opened with SHARE_READ. The asserted noDELETEsharing -> nohardlink proof assumes link creation requires DELETE; author found Microsoft FILE_LINK_INFORMATION remarks state no specific access rights are required. Sampling cannot itself exclude an alias created after current(true) and before set_len(0), which could clear another clone borrowing. Existing native assertion has not run and cannot establish that exclusion.
findings.required_change: Avoid content mutation through a potentially aliased file, preferably no-replace rename of the retained original handle with identity-bound create-only recovery; or establish an authoritative fully exclusive contract plus owned native regression. New native wrapper requires separate static review before execution.
findings.runtime_repro: No native reproduction or exploit confirmation claimed. Blocking source-contract gap: cross-clone mutation safety remains unproved; author withdrew the DELETE-access inference.
